liturgicalName: Palm Sunday of the Passion of the Lord
keyVerseDR: "Blessed be the king who cometh in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven and glory on high!" (Lk 19:38)

level1.title: Hosanna!
level1.story: Jesus rode a colt toward Jerusalem. His disciples spread their cloaks on the road. They praised God, saying, "Blessed is the King who comes!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, my King, I love You. Amen.

activity.title: Blessed is the King!
activity.intro: Decorate the letters to welcome Jesus.

level2.title: The King Enters Jerusalem
level2.story: Jesus sent two disciples to bring a colt on which no one had ever sat. As He rode, people spread their garments in the way. Near the Mount of Olives, the disciples began to praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works they had seen. They said, "Blessed be the King who cometh in the name of the Lord, peace in heaven, and glory on high!" When the Pharisees complained, Jesus said, "If these shall hold their peace, the stones will cry out."
level2.keyLine: Blessed be the king who cometh in the name of the Lord!
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How did Jesus show mercy even on the cross?
How will you walk with Jesus this week?
level2.prayer: Jesus, thank You for dying for me. Amen.

activity.title: Say it in one line
activity.intro: Think about the Gospel, then open to read a summary.
activity.question: Can you tell today's Gospel in one sentence?
activity.answer: Jesus rode into Jerusalem as the disciples praised God, saying, Blessed be the King who comes!

art.mainBrief: Jesus on a colt descending Mount of Olives; disciples praise
